overview: Host Danielle Balocca introduced the launch of the Medford Bytes podcast, outlining its focus on local current events, dining spots, and interviews with candidates ahead of the November 2 municipal election.

items.title: Medford Bytes Podcast Introduction
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduced the Medford Bytes podcast, announcing upcoming candidate interviews for the November 2 municipal election alongside coverage of local news and food recommendations.
